title: Anytime: Hike to the top of Stone Mountain

description: Granite dome summit trail, waterfalls and the historic Hutchinson Homestead. About 40 min away.

title: Anytime: Riverside trails at New River State Park
location: New River State Park, Laurel Springs / Jefferson, NC
description: Easy walks along one of the oldest rivers in the world.

title: Anytime: Drive up Mount Jefferson for the view
location: Mount Jefferson State Natural Area, Jefferson, NC
description: Paved road nearly to the summit, short trail to the overlook.

title: Anytime: Bluff Mountain views at Doughton Park
description: Open meadows and big views. Check Parkway road closures in winter.

title: Anytime: Murals, galleries and shops in West Jefferson
description: Walkable downtown with murals, galleries, cafes and Ashe County Cheese.

location: St. Mary's (West Jefferson) and Holy Trinity (Glendale Springs), NC
description: Ben Long's famous frescoes in two small mountain churches.

title: Anytime: Wander downtown Sparta
description: Small-town shops and places to eat, 20 minutes from the house.
